newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR OCT 14 - DEC 31, 1997 - (2 OF 2).
newsitem.headline: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR OCT 14 - DEC 31, 1997 - (2 OF 2).

text.p: STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (To February 21).

- Dutch EU presidency ends. Luxembourg takes over to December 31, 1997.
